Latin word

colō

colō, colere, coluī, cultum

verb, third conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

court, play up to (someone); grow, cultivate (plants, a field, a garden); court, pay attention to, cultivate (a person)

In this lexicon

  • flattery

    also used · classical · Traupman 361

  • grow

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fin. 4.38: vītem (Lewis & Short); Ov. Met. 14.624: hortōs (Lewis & Short); Traupman 166, 394

  • play up to

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 2.19.5: colere aliquem, beside observāre (Lewis & Short s.v. observō); Traupman 105: play up to s.o., aliquem colō
